# Geyser Developer Platform

> Build tools, connect applications, and follow agent work with Geyser’s open Python SDK, CLI, and local emulator.

- [Start](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/)
- [Five-minute emulator quickstart](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/quickstart/)
- [Python SDK](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/sdk/)
- [CLI reference](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/cli/)
- [Durable runs](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/durable-runs/)
- [OpenAPI and schemas](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/reference/)
- [Compatibility status](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/compatibility/)
- [Security](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/security/)
- [Canonical source](https://github.com/geyserlabs/geyser-open)

Geyser Open includes the MIT-licensed SDK, CLI, local emulator, schemas, and examples.
SDK and CLI 0.1.0 support Python 3.11–3.13. The SDK connects to Geyser's API;
the configured workspace supplies Agent runtimes, models, tools, and access.

- [Geyser website](https://www.geyserlabs.ai)
- [Customer guides](https://www.geyserlabs.ai/guides)
- [Practical recipes](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/recipes/)
- [Extensions](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/extensions/)
